verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents a Docker self-host path and a downloadable desktop app that gets 'a capable AI agent running on your device in minutes'. Community users confirm a single-install desktop package and a working setup in under 5 minutes. However, the pack never shows the actual one-line command (docker run, script, or package), and one Linux install needed a manual chrome-sandbox permission fix. Missing for 10: a documented exact one-command install (Docker run line or installer script), evidence that the Docker path reaches a working chat in minutes, and a smooth cross-platform install without manual fixes.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, I can install the assistant on my own machine with one documented command — installer script, npm/pip package, or Docker image — and reach a working chat in minutes

citations.quote: Download AnythingLLM and get a privacy-focused, extensible, and capable AI agent running on your device in minutes.
had it running in under 5 minutes
